svg.title: Evening in the commons
svg.desc: A solarpunk city at dusk: garden-draped towers with amber windows, turning wind turbines, a crescent moon and fireflies. On a rooftop garden, SOL-9, a small mended drone with a glowing teal eye, hovers over a planter with a seedling. Text: Nguyen Manh Khang, AI safety, alignment guild.
